label: Risograph print
description: Bold graphic shapes printed in two or three spot inks: grainy overprints, halftones and slightly misregistered layers.
suits: culture, music, design, strong opinions, young audiences
image: risograph print illustration, bold flat graphic shapes in a few overlapping spot-ink colours, grainy ink texture, halftone dot shading, slight misregistration between colour layers, a confident graphic-design composition
light: graphic rather than realistic light, shading built from halftone and overprinting
camera: graphic: bold straight moves, slides, snap reframes, flat staging
motion: limited graphic animation: shapes slide and pop with snappy timing while the print grain stays fixed to the paper
avoid: photorealism, 3D render, smooth gradients, soft painting
